args: [PROACTIVE-SWEEP] Run /proactive-repo-sweep on __HOME__/dev/ctrld-sync (GitHub repo abhimehro/ctrld-sync) in strict local-only mode (2B). Time-box this run to 15 minutes and produce at most 1 verified improvement (rotating bolt, code-health, and palette lenses across weekdays, plus a read-only sentinel check). Read __HOME__/dev/ctrld-sync/AGENTS.md and __HOME__/dev/ctrld-sync/.jules/ journals first, run __HOME__/dev/personal-config/scripts/proactive-worktree.sh cleanup --ttl-days 21 and check-throttle --repo abhimehro/ctrld-sync --include-worktrees --repo-path __HOME__/dev/ctrld-sync, check open-PR file collisions via check-collisions before editing, prepare an isolated local worktree via prepare --repo-path __HOME__/dev/ctrld-sync --lens <lens> --mode local, verify via verify --worktree <wt_path> --lens <lens> without modifying build, lock, script, or test harnesses, and if verify reports a semantic test-coverage BLOCK restore the lost coverage rather than deleting tests or pinning --expected-test-count, and write a chmod 600 digest report to __HOME__/.gemini/antigravity/proactive-reports/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-ctrld-sync.md. Do not push branches, open PRs, or edit .jules/sentinel.md.
description: Every weekday (Mon-Fri) at 08:15 local (America/Chicago), runs an isolated local-only proactive sweep on ctrld-sync ahead of the PR lifecycle.
